name: utc-ramona-sunrise
title: UTC → Ramona → Julian → Sunrise Highway loop
description: Hardwired demo ride: Westfield UTC out via Pomerado and 67 to Ramona, 78 through Santa Ysabel to Julian, 79 south to Sunrise Highway (S1) over Mount Laguna, Old 80 / Alpine home. ~224 km, ~3.3 h with the v0.2 profile. Used to exercise the routing engine and the Apple Maps handoff end to end.
notes: route_points are what GraphHopper routes through (lon, lat, GraphHopper order).
handoff_waypoints are the Apple Maps via-points, hand-picked at junctions where Apple's fastest route would otherwise leave ours. Phase 1 replaces them with the divergence heuristic in docs/API.md.
The return reuses ~15 km of Pomerado Road; accepted for a demo.
Start/end is on Nobel Dr, not inside the mall: a point on the private lot made Apple Maps say 'Walking required to reach destination'.
